overview_description.description: Spice Data provides B2B data licensing and data infrastructure focused on restaurant and food industry information. The company offers custom external data collection pipelines that gather, clean, and structure unstructured business and location data. Its platform delivers ongoing restaurant market data feeds that support enterprise clients with market research, analytics, and decision-making. Spice Data serves large organizations that require reliable, up-to-date external data rather than static databases. Its services emphasize scalable ingestion, refinement, and delivery of complex datasets tailored to specific enterprise needs. The company operates under the legal entity Pepper API, Inc. and works with clients through enterprise data licensing agreements.
